parameters.name: FeatureEntityIds
parameters.description: Filters the results by a list of feature entity IDs.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance. To obtain the ID, call the `ListInstances` API operation.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Filters the results by feature entity name.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- `Asc`: Ascending order.

- `Desc`: Descending order.

parameters.name: Owner
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the creator.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Values start at 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: ParentFeatureEntityId
parameters.description: Filters the results by parent feature entity ID. Omit this parameter to return all feature entities. Set it to `0` to return all root feature entities. Set it to a non-zero value to return all child feature entities of the specified parent.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description: The project ID. You can obtain this ID by calling the `ListProjects` operation.

parameters.name: SortBy
parameters.description: The field to sort the results by.
